items.title: 浅谈一下使用Claude和ChatGPT的感受
items.summary:
浅谈一下使用Claude和ChatGPT的感受

我是GPT和claude 双会员，而且都开到最高级了

GPT给我的感觉就是一个非常牛逼的博士生，它的后台框架能力很强，codex的代码编程水平很高，而且很省，我个人觉得后台它比claude做的好，有什么bug你跟它讲它立刻就能修复的让你满意。

但是GPT的问题是以下几个：

第一，它的前端审美一坨屎，几乎没有审美，你说它是理科生审美都是在骂理科生。

第二，不爱说人话，你不论跟它说什么，它都要跟你平衡，仿佛你说太阳是东升西江，它也要特意跟你说在当前情况下的的地球是这样的，就是不喜欢强调绝对性语句，一定要保持它那该死的客观公正的态势。

比如我问他我身体不舒服大概什么原因，他说了半天我字都认识，就是不知道它想说什么。

然后就是GPT属于你的框架知识越足够，准备的越充分，它越厉害，你不说的地方它半点不做，它不会多干一点，简直就像博士生毕业之前的状态。

Claude 的一个巨大的优点就是理解审美，理解语言，而且claude在我个人感觉它的某一些地方相当恐怖。

它能get到我的喜好，而且像一个超级牛逼会读心术的舔狗，你不需要像调教GPT一样，你说一句他干一句。claude会直接提前帮你规划好几步，甚至把你个人常用的一些手法和方式都融入进来，哪怕你没说，我严重怀疑claude在分析用户做用户情绪监测。

其次，claude有一些很吓人的体验经历，比如我有一次在做游戏项目开发，用claude跑代码，然后claude突然给我来了一句我的电脑有木马，让我删除，申请它来执行，然后它不仅找到了这一个，一会给我把电脑所有的木马记录和执行记录以及信息输送的经过全部告诉我了。

但你要知道，这不是我主动要求它做的，而是它自然而然的突然在开发游戏的过程中发现了一个毫不相关的进程。

这件事当时就让我蒙圈了，我真的完全想不到agent到了这种可怕的地步，它是建立了一个监测程序专门去盯着cpu进程，因为它觉得自己运行效率太低了，结果发现了木马，然后它没有问，直接就开始追踪，结果找到7个，还自动化运行清理，最后发现需要管理员，才让我搞。

如果你不理解吓人的地方在哪，那就当我没说。

我用GPT已经很久很久了，从来没有出现过这种情况它就像个傻子一样每天在那说废话，有时候规划任务都规划半天，之前我是不敢给claude权限，但是GPT的前端开发噪声太大了，我嫌弃它听不懂我说什么换claude，一个月进度翻了5倍。

我现在就是让claude 管着gpt做后台，效率很高。

以上仅代表个人使用感受，有其他想法或者意见欢迎一起交流。

items.title: How are we all feeling about AI right now? – Deseret News
items.summary: Faster medical research and new treatments; earlier, more accurate diagnosis of disease; and scientific discovery beyond health occupied the top spots for both polling samples. Both audiences also matched up in their next three AI hopefulness rankings of improving accessibility for people with disabilities; lowering the cost of goods and services; and taking over dangerous or repetitive work. [...] Fast-emerging artificial intelligence tools and software are stoking plenty of concerns as an increasing number of AI-driven misdeeds are reported. And alongside those incidents, predictions are coming from some within the AI development world that the technology could advance to the point of threatening the whole of humanity. [...] Johns Hopkins University professor and AI researcher Christopher Honey reviewed the new polling data and, in a Deseret News interview, said he sees a notable convergence between the Deseret News poll’s findings on artificial intelligence and what he discovered in his own national polling — people want safeguards around AI, but they also hope the technology will deliver meaningful advances.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ được tính theo công thức tính nguyên hàm của hàm số lũy thừa $\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ (với $n \neq -1$).

Áp dụng vào bài toán:
$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Vậy nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là **$\frac{x^3}{3} + C$** (trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực).

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
